key_insight: EvoOPD improves black-box distillation by evolving teacher-feedback strategies to match the student's changing learning needs.
engineering_relevance: It enables dense supervision from proprietary models without teacher logits by converting textual feedback through a privileged-information-conditioned teacher.
method: Maintain a bank of privileged-information acquisition strategies.
Measure feedback repair utility on the current student's trajectories.
Adapt feedback focus, information type, and granularity as training progresses.
evidence_signal: Across mathematics and code generation with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B students, EvoOPD ranked best in all six settings, averaging gains over each setting's strongest baseline of 2.14 percentage points in mathematics and 1.30 in code.
watch_item: Adaptive feedback acquisition and repair-utility measurement may add teacher-query and training overhead; the abstract does not quantify these costs.
paper_title: EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
